scope: File inventory plus ten existing episodes; no rendering or semantic validation
sampling: Eight GuidedVLA task names plus handover_block and place_object_stand; one sorted-file choice per task using Python random.Random(seed)

samples.instruction: ["Grab the medium dark brown bottle from the table with the right arm"]
["Pick the yellow and black hammer grip from the table and strike"]
["Ask the right arm to interact with the compact bell with round base's top."]
["Take the simple white plastic trashbin and pour the balls."]
["Take the compact red playingcards pack and push it further away."]
["Grab the round kitchenpot with handles and lift it up"]
["With two arms, pick the orange-white hamburg with yellow highlight and the McDonald's logo on red fries box for the tray with slightly raised edges."]
["Lift the smooth light brown can, set it in the yellow basket, and elevate the yellow basket."]
["Hold the red block with the left arm and place it on the pad."]
["Place the white bell on the smooth black rectangular displaystand."]
